spans.s:
मिश्रक a. mingled, miscellaneous;
 mixing, adulterating.
मिश्रकेशी f. N. of an Apsaras.
2 मिश॑धान्य a. mixed of various kinds of grain.

मिश्रय् मिश˚यति pp. मिशित mix, mingle with (instr. or
loc.). — वि & सम् = S.

मिशी@कृ = prec., w. भू mix, associate with (instr.),
also of sex. intercourse.

मिष् मिष॑ति (मिष॑˚ते) open the eyes, look, behold (only
the pres. pp. मिष॑न्त्, esp. in constructions as मिषतो
बन्धुवर्गस्य before the eyes of the friends). — उद् = S. + blossom,
expand. नि close the eyes, wink, fall asleep. — Cf. उन्मिषित.

मिष्ट a. savoury, dainty, sweet;
 n. = seq.
मिसि f. N. of sev. plants.
